Keep chibi proportions: oversized head, short torso, SHORT compact limbs. Natural connected anatomy, exactly two arms and two legs. No long straps/tubes replacing limbs, no detached hands, no duplicate arms. Transparent background with real alpha, no text, no borders, no room, no floor, no cast shadow. Full character including hair and tail, ample transparent padding; character centered and about 80% of canvas height. This must visibly be sitting, never standing. Do not lengthen her legs.
